text: In 1994, one ad got clicked by almost half the people who saw it.
say: In nineteen ninety-four, one ad got clicked by almost half the people who saw it.

text: It was the very first banner ad on the internet.

text: AT&T paid $30,000 for one spot, for three months.
say: A T and T paid thirty thousand dollars for one spot, for three months.

text: The ad asked: have you ever clicked your mouse right here?

text: But here's the part nobody remembers.
